comment: Published release tags, newest first. The documented rollback target and the bump tooling derive from this file; a release enters it when its tag is pushed and validated. CHANGELOG headings are not a substitute: 1.6.0 and 1.7.0 were described there but never tagged. Neither is a tag: v1.8.0 is pushed to origin and has no GitHub release, so it never went through publish-release.yml and nothing validated it. A tag that exists is evidence of a tag, not of a release.
